title: Apple & Blackberry Crumble
hookLine: British-inspired apple & blackberry crumble with 9 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Dip & Coat Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat oven to 190C/170C fan/gas 5. Tip the flour and sugar into a large bowl. Add the butter, then rub into the flour using your fingertips to make a light breadcrumb texture. Do not overwork it or the crumble will become heavy. Sprinkle the mixture evenly over a baking sheet and bake for 15 mins or until lightly coloured. Incorporate {m52893_1}, {m52893_2}, {m52893_3}, and {m52893_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure plain flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Meanwhile, for the compote, peel, core and cut the apples into 2cm dice. Put the butter and sugar in a medium saucepan and melt together over a medium heat. Cook for 3 mins until the mixture turns to a light caramel. Stir in the apples and cook for 3 mins. Add the blackberries and cinnamon, and cook for 3 mins more. Cover, remove from the heat, then leave for 2-3 mins to continue cooking in the warmth of the pan. Incorporate {m52893_5} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Combine Wet & Dry Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Fold {m52893_6}, {m52893_7}, {m52893_8}, and {m52893_9} into the base in two additions using gentle strokes until glossy and uniform with zero dry pockets. Avoid overmixing so the final texture stays light and tender.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: To serve, spoon the warm fruit into an ovenproof gratin dish, top with the crumble mix, then reheat in the oven for 5-10 mins. Serve with vanilla ice cream.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Chill the filled crust 10 minutes before baking—cold butter hits the hot oven and puffs into extra-flaky layers.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
